image_description: A close-up portrait of a mature male orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus). The image focuses on the head and upper shoulders, showcasing the characteristic broad face, prominent cheek pads (flanges), and long shaggy reddish-brown fur. The eyes are dark and forward-facing, and the expression appears calm. The background is blurred, emphasizing the subject.
